spanish: Y alma, cuando tocare en todo impuro, en impureza de adam o en animal impuro o en todo abominable impuro, y comiere desde carne de sacrificio de los pazes que a Jehová, y será cortada el alma aquella desde sus pueblos.

findings.issue: אָדָם is a common noun (not a proper name); adam leaves it untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.
שֶׁקֶץ is a masculine singular noun; abominable is an adjective, so the nominal head is missing.
וְאָכַל is qal 3ms; comiere does not mark masculine and continues the feminine alma.

notes: Article contrast on נפש, the או alternation, the verbless אשר ליהוה, niphal 3fs, and plural עַמֶּיהָ are preserved.
